verdict.rationale: Docs describe a 'Motion' liveness check (head-turn/randomized movements) and facial similarity/known-faces matching, which are liveness-adjacent anti-fraud features, but nothing names specific defenses against AI-generated faces, deepfakes, or camera-injection attacks as distinct detection capabilities. missing for 10: named deepfake-detection capability, named camera/virtual-camera injection detection, named AI-generated/synthetic face detection, any technical description of how liveness models distinguish real vs. injected/synthetic media.
